candidates.source_name: Česká bankovní asociace (ČBA) — seznam členů a přidružených členů
candidates.why_relevant: Complete enumeration of the licensed Czech banking sector (~32-35 members representing >99% of the market), split into full members (banks and branches of foreign banks with a ČNB licence) and associate members (representative offices and banking auxiliary organisations). The associate-member tier is the highest-value part for vendor scouting: it is where non-bank service providers to banks appear.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic HTML scrape of the member list page; diff member set quarterly to detect entries/exits and new associate members.
candidates.discovered_via_method: seed query + local-language search, then direct fetch
queries_used: Česká bankovní asociace členové přidružení členové
Czech banking association members list

candidates.source_name: ČBA — Komise a pracovní skupiny (commissions and working groups)
candidates.why_relevant: ČBA handles professional topics through commissions, sub-commissions and working groups staffed by member-bank representatives. Rosters and topic areas (payments, cards, open banking, digitalisation, AML) reveal which institutions — and which people — sit at the table on upcoming regulation, and which technical schemes ČBA itself operates.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: HTML scrape + snowball into each commission subpage; cross-reference names to LinkedIn/bank org charts.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search on 'komise a pracovní skupiny'
queries_used: cbaonline.cz komise a pracovní skupiny platební styk

candidates.source_name: ČBA — schéma okamžitých plateb / standardy a dokumenty ke stažení
candidates.why_relevant: ČBA publishes the rulebooks and standards for national payment schemes (okamžité platby / instant payments, API standards for open banking). These documents name participating institutions, scheme roles and technical requirements — direct evidence of what vendors must build to and who has joined.
candidates.legal_status: publicly posted PDF; copyright of ČBA — cite, do not republish
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl the journal_files_storage / documents section for PDFs; version-track rulebooks.
candidates.discovered_via_method: search result snowball from working-group query
queries_used: cbaonline.cz komise a pracovní skupiny platební styk

candidates.source_name: Česká fintech asociace (ČEFTAS) — Členové (regular + affiliate)
candidates.why_relevant: The single best enumeration of the Czech fintech/insurtech/regtech scene. Two tiers: regular members (fintech solution providers — GoPay, ComGate, Twisto, Dateio, MONET+, Wultra, Zentity, Coinmate, BudgetBakers etc.) and affiliate members (Visa, Mastercard, ING, Deloitte, law firms, banks) — i.e. the ecosystem AND its sponsors/partners in one place.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape both cs and en member pages; each member card typically links to the company site — snowball into a vendor master list.
candidates.discovered_via_method: seed query, confirmed by direct fetch of the members page
queries_used: Česká fintech asociace seznam členů
czechfintech.cz Česká fintech asociace členové oficiální web

candidates.source_name: Česká leasingová a finanční asociace (ČLFA) — Seznam členských společností
candidates.why_relevant: ~35 members covering the non-bank financing market: leasing, consumer credit, instalment sales, factoring (claimed ~86% business financing, ~83% consumer financing, ~95% factoring share). Enumerates captive finance arms (BMW FS, Ayvens, Arval) and independent lenders — a segment of payment/lending IT buyers that banking associations miss. Each member has its own detail page (/spolecnosti/<slug>).
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape list page, then follow each /spolecnosti/ detail page for contacts and profile.
queries_used: ČLFA Česká leasingová a finanční asociace seznam členů clfa.cz

candidates.source_name: APEK — Asociace pro elektronickou komerci, Seznam členů
candidates.why_relevant: 580+ members: e-shops (the merchant demand side for payment acceptance) plus the vendors that serve them — payment gateways, PSPs, logistics and e-commerce platforms. The merchant enumeration is the acquiring-side counterpart to the ČBA bank list. APEK also runs the 'APEK Certifikovaný obchod' programme with its own separate member listing.
candidates.source_subtype: trade association member directory + certification registry
candidates.access_status: open list; a 'Členská zóna' login gates deeper member content
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape the alphabetically filtered listing (letter filter query params observed, e.g. filters_member[letter]=W) to page the whole set; do not attempt the member zone.
queries_used: APEK asociace pro elektronickou komerci seznam členů platební brány
candidates.observed_blocker: Členská zóna (member zone) login page exists at /prihlaseni; public list appears open

candidates.source_name: SOCR ČR (Svaz obchodu a cestovního ruchu) — Členská základna
candidates.why_relevant: Retail and hospitality confederation — the physical-POS merchant side (grocery chains, retail, gastro, accommodation). Its members include other associations (e.g. APEK itself is listed as a member with a detail page), so it is a pointer-of-pointers into the merchant ecosystem that buys card terminals and POS.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape /clenska-zakladna and follow /clen/<slug> detail pages; flag member entries that are themselves associations for snowballing.
candidates.discovered_via_method: Czech-language search; confirmed member-detail URL pattern via APEK cross-listing
queries_used: SOCR ČR svaz obchodu a cestovního ruchu seznam členů

candidates.source_name: ICT UNIE — Členové ICTU
candidates.why_relevant: Enumerates the Czech IT supplier base that serves banks and the public sector — Aricoma, Asseco Central Europe, Asseco Solutions, DXC, Deloitte Advisory, ICZ and similar system integrators. This is the vendor/competitor bench for banking IT delivery in CZ. English mirror at /en/ictu-members.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape cs + en member lists; note that an older site structure (www.ictu.cz/o-ict-unii/clenove/) may still resolve and hold honorary members.
queries_used: ICT Unie členové seznam ictu.cz

candidates.source_name: ICT UNIE — Pracovní skupiny a Orgány
candidates.why_relevant: Working groups and board composition show which IT vendors lead on eGovernment, digital identity, cybersecurity and data topics — a direct read on which suppliers are positioned on regulation and public-sector digitalisation that spills into banking (eID, bankID, NIS2).
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape working-group and bodies pages; also mine the PDF archive at api.ictu.cz/storage/ for general-assembly minutes naming members.
candidates.discovered_via_method: snowball from ICT UNIE member page search
queries_used: ICT Unie členové seznam ictu.cz

candidates.source_name: SPIR — Sdružení pro internetový rozvoj, Členové
candidates.why_relevant: Members are the Czech internet economy: publishers, media and creative agencies, technology companies, operators and e-commerce projects. Useful for the digital-marketing/adtech and e-commerce adjacency of payments, and for identifying who runs the digital channels of banks and merchants. Executive council composition signals sector power structure.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape member list and governing-body pages; an English mirror exists on the legacy old.spir.cz host.
queries_used: SPIR sdružení pro internetový rozvoj členové

candidates.source_name: AmCham Czech Republic — Membership Directory (corporate)
candidates.why_relevant: Enumerates US-linked and multinational corporates in CZ, including financial-services players (Citibank appears on the board). The board of directors list is itself a who's-who of country managers. Committees and 'Plus Club' groupings indicate which firms lobby on digital/financial policy.
candidates.access_status: open listing; individual member detail pages use numeric IDs
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape the corporate directory (paginated / ID-based detail URLs observed, e.g. /membership-directory/corporate/2370688) and the board page; filter to financial services and IT.
queries_used: AmCham Czech Republic member directory

candidates.source_name: British Chamber of Commerce Czech Republic — Members Directory
candidates.why_relevant: 200+ member companies, UK-linked; relevant for UK fintech/payments vendors entering CZ and for professional-services partners. Smaller than AmCham but with a distinct membership tail; board page names the active corporate participants.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Single-page or paginated scrape of the directory plus the board-members page.
queries_used: British Chamber of Commerce Czech Republic members

candidates.source_name: ČNB — České a vybrané mezinárodní asociace na finančním trhu
candidates.why_relevant: The regulator's own curated index of Czech financial-market associations — banking (ČBA), credit unions (ADZ), insurance (ČAP, AČPM, ČSpA, KSLPU), capital markets (AKAT, ČASF), pensions (APF ČR) — each with its website. This is the authoritative pointer-of-pointers that guarantees the association layer of the map is complete and not invented.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Fetch once per quarter, extract the association->URL table, and use it as the seed list for association-directory crawling.
candidates.discovered_via_method: Czech-language search for payment-services associations; fetched and read directly
queries_used: asociace platebních institucí Česko sdružení poskytovatelů platebních služeb členové AKAT ČAP seznam členů

candidates.source_name: ASPPS ČR — Asociace poskytovatelů platebních služeb České republiky
candidates.why_relevant: The only association found that is specifically dedicated to payment service providers (non-bank PSPs / platební instituce) in CZ; it states it represents PSP interests toward the legislature, ministries and state administration. Directly on-topic for the payments workstream, though the site appears small/possibly dormant (plain http, .eu domain) so membership depth is unverified.
candidates.access_status: unverified — not fetched in this pass
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Manual first inspection to establish whether a member list exists and whether the site is still maintained; corroborate legal existence via the commercial register (IČO 04387783).
candidates.discovered_via_method: Czech-language search for a payment-provider association; register cross-check
queries_used: sdružení poskytovatelů platebních služeb členové

candidates.source_name: Sdružení pro bankovní karty (SBK) — činnost a členové
candidates.why_relevant: The Czech card-payments professional association — banks and other organisations interested in developing payment cards and coordinating related work, with regular membership limited to financial institutions. Historically the venue where card-scheme, acquiring and terminal topics were coordinated; also a source of card-market statistics. Two co-existing domains observed (bankovnikarty.cz and bankovni-karty.cz) suggest a legacy/possibly dormant web presence.
candidates.access_status: unverified — not fetched in this pass; site looks legacy static HTML
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Fetch both domains; if dead, retrieve historical member lists and card statistics from Webarchiv.cz / Internet Archive.
queries_used: Sdružení pro bankovní karty členové

candidates.source_name: AKAT ČR — Asociace pro kapitálový trh, Členové asociace a Orgány
candidates.why_relevant: Capital-market members: asset managers, investment firms, banks (Česká spořitelna appears as a member) and their advisers (law firms such as BBH sit in the association's bodies). Adds the investment/wealth segment of financial institutions and their service providers, which the banking and fintech associations only partially cover. Structured member-detail URLs make it machine-friendly.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape the member list, then iterate the MemberDetails/id/<n> URLs; also capture the Orgány page for adviser firms.
queries_used: AKAT ČAP seznam členů

candidates.source_name: Česká asociace pojišťoven (ČAP) — Řádní členové
candidates.why_relevant: Full enumeration of Czech insurers — the insurtech/bancassurance counterparty set and a distinct buyer group for payments, billing and core-system IT. Relevant to 'sector=both' coverage where banking and insurance overlap (bank-owned insurers, embedded insurance in payments).
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape the members page; monitor the press-centre feed for governance changes and position papers.
queries_used: ČAP seznam členů

candidates.source_name: Svaz průmyslu a dopravy ČR (SP ČR) — Členská základna / odvětvové svazy
candidates.why_relevant: Top-level confederation whose collective members ARE the sector associations — ČBA, Česká fintech asociace and ICT UNIE all appear with their own SP ČR profile pages. Because SP ČR profiles restate each association's identity and contacts, it works as an independent cross-check on association existence and as a discovery surface for associations not yet on the map.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape /struktura-sp-cr/clenska-zakladna and the odvetvove-svazy/seznam-clenu listing; harvest /component/spcr/clen/<id> and /seznam-clenu/<id> detail pages.
candidates.discovered_via_method: appeared repeatedly as the canonical cross-reference in association searches
queries_used: Svaz průmyslu a dopravy členská základna

candidates.source_name: Hospodářská komora ČR — struktura, začleněné živnostenské a oborové asociace
candidates.why_relevant: ~17,000 members organised in 57 territorial chambers and ~140 sector associations; the Czech Fintech Association states it is a member. The list of incorporated sector associations is a second, independent enumeration of the association layer, and regional chamber sites publish their own member lists (useful for the merchant long tail outside Prague).
candidates.access_status: open; central member search may be partly gated
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Extract the sector-association index from komora.cz; for merchant enumeration, harvest regional chamber member lists (e.g. ohkbv.cz, ohk.jesenik.com) which publish plain HTML directories.

candidates.source_name: Czech ICT Alliance — členové (CzechTrade export alliance)
candidates.why_relevant: ~160 Czech ICT companies organised as a CzechTrade-backed export alliance (Asseco Solutions, Cleverlance, ICZ, Komix, Sophia Solutions, plus CZ arms of Cisco, HP, Intel, Microsoft). Complements ICT UNIE by highlighting which local IT suppliers are actively export-oriented — i.e. the most likely regional competitors for banking IT deals.
candidates.access_status: unverified — legacy http site, not fetched in this pass
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Fetch the member section; if the site is stale, corroborate against CzechTrade listings and the Wikipedia/company-register entry (IČO 75066335).
queries_used: Czech ICT Alliance members

candidates.why_relevant: The largest bilateral chamber in CZ (~700 members) and operator of a company database of ~1,500 German firms active in the Czech market (nemeckefirmy.cz), in Czech and German. Useful for identifying German-owned banks, captive finance arms and IT suppliers operating locally — a group the domestic associations under-represent.
candidates.access_status: open chamber site; database access model unverified
candidates.legal_status: public website; database may have its own terms
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Inspect nemeckefirmy.cz for a filterable directory; scrape financial-services and IT categories only. Check terms of use before bulk extraction.

candidates.source_name: Česká kryptoměnová asociace (ČKMA)
candidates.why_relevant: Represents Czech crypto-asset businesses and users. Under MiCA this is the association layer for CASPs — a set of payment-adjacent firms (exchanges, custody, on/off-ramps) that no banking or fintech association fully enumerates, and a likely counterparty for banks on debanking and MiCA compliance topics.
candidates.access_status: unverified — not fetched in this pass
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Check for a member/partner page; supplement with the association's social feeds (X, Facebook) which are actively used for positions and member announcements.

candidates.source_name: Asociace penzijních společností ČR (APF ČR) a Asociace družstevních záložen (ADZ)
candidates.why_relevant: Two remaining association slots from the regulator's own index: pension management companies (APF ČR) and credit unions (ADZ, asociacedz.cz). Both enumerate small but distinct classes of regulated financial institutions that buy core systems and payment connectivity, completing the CZ financial-institution census beyond banks, insurers and asset managers.
candidates.access_status: unverified — URLs taken from the ČNB index, not fetched
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Low-frequency fetch (annual) of member pages; these memberships change rarely.

negative_findings.description: No active, well-maintained Czech association dedicated specifically to non-bank payment institutions / PSPs with a public member list was confirmed. ASPPS ČR (aspps.eu, IČO 04387783) exists in the commercial register and describes an advocacy role, but its web presence looks minimal (plain http, .eu domain) and no member list was observed.
negative_findings.result_summary: ASPPS ČR identified as the only candidate; membership depth unverified. In practice the PSP population is covered by Česká fintech asociace rather than a dedicated PSP body.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Means there is no single association-side census of Czech payment institutions; the ČNB licence register must carry that load, with ČEFTAS as the commercial-signal overlay.

negative_findings.description: Sdružení pro bankovní karty (SBK) appears under two domains (bankovnikarty.cz and bankovni-karty.cz) with legacy static-HTML page structures and no recent activity surfaced in search.
negative_findings.result_summary: Statutes and a 'činnost a členové' page were indexed, but currency could not be established in this pass. Recorded as unverified, not dead.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: SBK was historically the coordination venue for Czech card payments and card-market statistics; if dormant, that coordination has migrated to ČBA commissions and the schemes themselves, which changes where card-market intelligence should be collected.

negative_findings.description: APEK operates a members-only zone (apek.cz/prihlaseni) behind which richer member data and materials likely sit; only the public alphabetical member list is openly enumerable.
negative_findings.result_summary: Public list is collectable; the member zone is out of scope and should not be accessed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The 580+ merchant enumeration remains usable, but any member-only vendor briefings or benchmark data are not legitimately collectable and should not be assumed available.

negative_findings.description: Searches surfaced association member and working-group directories but no association-hosted case-study or reference-implementation library for banking/payments technology in CZ.
negative_findings.result_summary: Associations publish position papers, rulebooks and statistics rather than vendor case studies; the closest substitutes found are ČBA scheme rulebooks and conference/PDF archives (e.g. ICT UNIE assembly minutes, ČBA presentations hosted on university sites).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The 'case studies' topic for this cell must be served indirectly — via association event programmes and member presentations — rather than by a directory. Another cell (vendor websites / conferences) should own it.

negative_findings.description: The Czech Banking Association is reachable under at least two domains — cbaonline.cz (current site, member list and working groups) and czech-ba.cz (the domain the ČNB index still links, with its own /cs/o-cba/komise-pracovni-organy path).
negative_findings.result_summary: Both appear live in search results; which is canonical was not established.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A collector pinned to the wrong host risks silent staleness or duplicate records for the same association; the canonical host must be resolved before scheduling recurring collection.

coverage_gaps.description: For several directories (APEK 580+, SP ČR, HK ČR ~140 sector associations, AmCham) only the entry page was identified; pagination scheme, total record count and whether member entries carry structured metadata (sector, size, website) were not established.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a structure-probing pass per directory: identify pagination/filter parameters (APEK's filters_member[letter] pattern is a confirmed example) and the member-detail URL template before committing to a scraper.

coverage_gaps.description: No association was found that specifically organises POS/terminal, ATM or cash-handling suppliers in CZ; these vendors appear only scattered across ICT UNIE, Czech ICT Alliance and APEK.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Treat the POS/ATM supplier population as un-enumerable from the association layer; source it instead from public procurement, ČNB registers and merchant-facing gateway partner pages.

coverage_gaps.description: Working-group pages were confirmed to exist for ČBA and ICT UNIE, but it is unknown whether either publishes named participant rosters or only topic descriptions and chairs.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Fetch each working-group subpage and record whether individual participants/member institutions are named; if not, fall back to conference speaker lists and consultation-response documents (e.g. ČNB/MF public-consultation outcome PDFs, which do name responding institutions).

coverage_gaps.description: German-language coverage was only touched via ČNOPK; the run scope is cs+en, so the German bilateral chamber's German-side content and the nemeckefirmy.cz database were not explored in their native language.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: If German-owned financial institutions matter to the analysis, extend the language set to de for the ČNOPK sub-branch only; otherwise accept the gap explicitly.

coverage_gaps.description: No archival strategy was established for association member lists, which are overwritten in place — so entries/exits and vendor churn cannot be reconstructed retrospectively.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Seed the collection with Webarchiv.cz and Internet Archive snapshots of ČBA, ČEFTAS, ČLFA and APEK member pages to build a back-history before starting forward diffing.

brief: The Czech association layer is unusually well-structured and cheap to mine: ČNB itself publishes a curated index of financial-market associations, and Svaz průmyslu a dopravy plus Hospodářská komora provide two independent cross-checks on that same set, so the association census can be closed with high confidence rather than guessed. Four directories carry most of the value — ČBA (the licensed banking sector, with an associate-member tier that exposes bank service providers), Česká fintech asociace (fintech/PSP scene plus Visa, Mastercard and consultancy affiliates), ČLFA (non-bank lending, leasing and factoring), and APEK/SOCR (the online and physical merchant demand side) — while ICT UNIE and Czech ICT Alliance enumerate the system integrators that actually deliver banking IT. Working-group and commission pages at ČBA and ICT UNIE are the highest-signal, lowest-volume asset in the cell, since they show which institutions sit at the table on payments, open banking and digital-identity regulation; their granularity is the main unverified question. Weak spots are a dormant-looking card association (SBK), no dedicated payment-institution body with a public roster, and no association-side case-study layer — those topics must be served from registers, procurement and vendor-side sources instead.
